proposal.author: Sam — Robot Hand Integration and Manipulation
proposal.text: Integrated fingertip cartridge: rigid core with 2x M3 holder screws carries PCB with capacitive taxels plus PVDF vibration film under silicone pillar dielectric and outer skin, readout by row-column mux to MCU to rear 4-wire bus. Radial stack PCB 1.6 mm plus pillars 1.0 mm plus PVDF 0.11 mm plus skin 1.5 mm equals 4.21 mm, fits in 15-20 mm diameter hemispherical cap with 7 mm core for screws. Single design load 30 N nominal grip (100 kPa over 300 mm2); 139 N Hand-E limit is survival proof only; 14.8 N for 1 kg at 5 m/s2 is normal operating point inside envelope. Energy flow grip load into rigid holder not skin mount; signal flow contact compression to capacitance plus charge to CDC plus charge amp to MCU to bus; grasp law increase grip on slip transient, hold steady when stable.
